title: Max Subarray Sum
description: Write a function `max_subarray_sum(nums: list[int]) -> int` that returns the maximum sum of a contiguous subarray in an array of integers. For an empty list, return 0.

title: Is Palindrome Permutation
description: Write a function `can_form_palindrome(s: str) -> bool` that returns True if the characters of string `s` can be rearranged to form a palindrome, ignoring case.
ground_truth_solution:
from collections import Counter
def can_form_palindrome(s: str) -> bool:
    s_clean = s.lower()
    counts = Counter(s_clean)
    odd_count = sum(1 for char, count in counts.items() if count % 2 != 0)
    return odd_count <= 1
